title: Mt. St. Helens
location: Lahar Viewpoint, Mount St. Helens, WA
imageAlt: A view of Mt. St. Helens from Lahar Viewpoint.
text: To close out the summer we camped just south of Mt. St. Helens over Labor Day weekend. We got up close to the crater, and walked the lava canyon where the 1980 mudflow scoured the rock down to bare basalt.

title: Patterson Lake in August
imageAlt: Cabins beyond a lawn, beach with kayaks in the foreground.
text: Back to the Sun Mountain cabins, this time with the lake unfrozen and the kayaks out. Wildfire smoke sat over the valley all week, which was a damper on the hiking but did turn every sunset orange.

title: New Plant
location: Found in the North Cascades, WA
imageAlt: A red pearled succulent plant on a bed of rocks in front of a window.
text: We went backpacking in the North Cascades and I found this little guy growing out of a rock field. It has been on the windowsill ever since, and checking it for new sprouts has quietly become part of my morning routine.

title: Columbia River Sunset
imageAlt: A view of the Columbia River from Kalama, WA with a Mississippi style steamboat off to the side.
text: Another stamp in the McMenamins passport, this one at the Kalama Harbor Lodge. The food was good. The sunset over the Columbia, with that steamboat parked in the middle of it, was better.

title: Annual Lantern Festival
imageAlt: A sky full of lanterns floating into the night sky, over a crowd of people in the center of a race track.
text: Our yearly trip to the Night Lights Lantern Festival in Idaho. Everyone crowds into the infield of a race track and sends their lantern up at the same moment, which is the two minutes this photo is trying to hold onto.

title: Fluid Architecture
imageAlt: A view of a German building with fluid, curving architecture.
text: While I love living in the states, going back to Germany to visit family is always a treat. Especially when I run into a building like this one, where nothing is a straight line and the whole street feels like it wandered out of a fairytale.

title: Russell Cave
imageAlt: A view of a stream flowing into a cave in the middle of a forest.
text: We were visiting family in Tennessee and made a day trip across the Alabama line to this cave. People sheltered in that entrance more than 12,000 years ago, which is a hard number to hold in your head while standing in front of it.

title: Patterson Lake, Frozen Over
imageAlt: Cabins covered in snow, seen from the surface of a frozen lake.
text: The family took the Sun Mountain cabins for the long weekend in January. Not much fresh snow fell, but the lake had frozen end to end, so this photo is taken standing on water.

title: Bean in the Sunshine
imageAlt: My cat Bean sitting between the curtains and the sunlit window, casting an iconic cat shaped shadow.
text: Bean loves basking in the sunlight, even when there are no birds to watch. The shadow on the curtain is doing most of the work here.

title: Ooey Gooey Mushroom
imageAlt: A closeup of a mushroom covered in amber colored droplets, growing in a forest.
text: Stumbled on this one halfway through a nature walk. Every cap was beaded with amber droplets, like the whole thing was sweating.
